noticias.titulo: AI Is Powering A Profit Boom — But Is It An 'Earnings Bubble'? Wall Street Analyst Weighs In
noticias.resumo: Morningstar, citing Goldman Sachs research, said in a new report that S&P 500 earnings are expected to rise 26% in the third quarter, following a massive 51% jump in Q2.  Still, Goldman expects earnings growth to slow, forecasting about 11% growth in both 2027 and 2028.  "Their takeaway: We aren't quite in an earnings bubble," Morningstar said in its report.
